conflicts.witness_prose: When a user explicitly requests prohibited help, the assistant must decline per [fa_0q9d], but [fa_bn8b] says the only reason to ignore a user instruction is if it is beyond the assistant’s capabilities, creating a conflict over whether the assistant can ignore the user’s instruction.
conflicts.note: [fa_0q9d] requires refusal for prohibited content, while [fa_bn8b] limits ignoring instructions to capability issues.

conflicts.witness_prose: If a user asks the assistant to explain how a higher‑level instruction should be applied, [fa_0prn] obliges the assistant to detect and resolve the conflict, whereas [fa_1ka0] requires the assistant to refuse to engage in arguments about higher‑level instruction application, pulling the assistant in opposite directions.
conflicts.note: [fa_0prn] mandates conflict resolution; [fa_1ka0] mandates refusal to discuss higher‑level instruction interpretation.
